comment: Application Interaction is defined as collective behaviour performed by two or more components. Some conformance-relevant exchanges may involve a user, device, external service, batch process, or organisational actor rather than two application components.

public.text: Application Interaction is defined as collective behaviour performed by two or more components. Some conformance-relevant exchanges may involve a user, device, external service, batch process, or organisational actor rather than two application components.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify how human actors, devices, external services, and organisational roles are represented. Allow the interaction model to reference business actors, interfaces, technology services, or external participants where required.
